fusions.name: Sprung Jaw
fusions.desc: You lunge up to 5 tiles to the target and strike it for 13 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Still Water Breaks
fusions.desc: After a 1.2 second cast, arcana bursts from you, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Lurking Glyph
fusions.desc: After a 1 second cast, sets a glyph at the nearest enemy that arms after 1 second and waits up to 30 seconds. The first enemy to come within 2 tiles sets it off, and it deals 22 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 6. Your next critical hit spends them all: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
